selectionBasis: Public problem statements describe existing incorrect behavior. Selection precedes coding and grader outcomes. These are new candidates, not a resumed cohort or an execution-ready freeze.

tasks.evidence: A binary UTF-8 payload worked in Requests 2.8.1 and fails after the 2.9 regression.
A host beginning with a dot raises UnicodeError instead of the library's InvalidURL exception.
Proxy URL parsing drops authentication and produces HTTP 407 instead of successful proxy authentication.
The existing Morse mapping encodes the numeral one incorrectly.
srepr omits symbolic element representations inside dictionaries and sets.
Constructing a Rational from string inputs returns a different incorrect value from equivalent numeric inputs.
